<!-- pr-reviewer: c4ac0b6415d59a400a23e19c8982ab53726f8761 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**Build and test location.** Locally, in a fresh worktree. The head merged cleanly with origin/main (a529c4553). The trial merge had no conflicts.

**Results on the merged head**
- camcraft-ui lib suite, full run: `test result: ok. 953 passed; 0 failed; 6 ignored; exit 0`.
- Filter `floor`: `test result: ok. 8 passed; 0 failed`. The four new pinning tests pass.
- Filter `work_envelope`: `test result: ok. 5 passed; 0 failed`.
- Filters `structural` and `lathe_view`: `test result: ok. 18 passed; 0 failed`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, exit 0.
- The one lib failure the body reported is issue #2170. Its fix merged into main. This head does not fail.

**Line-ending check.** The diff carries no LF-to-CRLF churn. Each file's changed-line count is the same with `--ignore-cr-at-eol`.

**Law notes**
- The floor is a read of the world at each frame. It writes no field, so no new command is needed. Temporary view state is exempt (AGENTS.md "Everything Is a Command"). Undo and redo follow by construction.
- The display-only choice obeys the constraint in issue #2172: a stored move could change posted coordinates. `docs/decisions/2172-viewport-floor.md` records the decision and the dropped alternative.
- No file in `crates/app`, `post`, `sim` or `cl` changes. `the_floor_never_changes_the_posted_records_or_the_checks` pins that the records and the check findings do not change.
- No snapshot PNG changed. No process file changed. No new dependency. The subject is conventional. The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #2172`.
- `crates/ui/src/floor.rs` has the provenance line. It rejects a non-finite floor and a floor past 1e7 mm with a fallback to Z=0. No panic path on a user path.

**Notes, not blocking**
- The issue says the model and the stock move up with the fixture. This change puts the floor under the bodies instead. The viewport picture is the same. The maintainer may want to read the decision file first for that interpretation.
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` is 1806 lines. The 400-line rule asks for a later split. This PR adds 6 lines to it.
- `floor_z` walks every triangle of every counted body in each frame. A later speed-up can take the lowest Z from the body's world aabb. The current cost is one extra pass next to `world::collect`, so it is small.
- The decision file says a test "compares the bytes". The test compares the record stream, as the PR body states. A one-word fix for a later pass.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
